info.title: Visor Public API
info.summary: US vehicle listings, market facets, VIN history, and dealer data.
info.description: US vehicle listing data collected from dealer websites. Search active and sold listings, count and aggregate them by facet (prices, trims, market mix), look up a VIN's status, build, and latest listing, and find dealers and their inventory. Authenticate with Authorization: Bearer <api_key>; create a key at https://visor.vin/account/api. Data requests are billed per request against prepaid API credit; GET /v1/usage is free. This document is public at https://api.visor.vin/v1/openapi.json.
info.x-cli-description: Query Visor vehicle listings, facets, VIN detail, and dealer inventory from a scriptable CLI.

get.description:
Search US vehicle listings; returns one page of listing summaries. Active by default; inventory_status=sold or sold_within_days returns sold listings, snapshot_date a past day's inventory. Each VIN appears once, at the dealer Visor attributes it to. Use GET /v1/facets for counts, filter values, and price stats, and GET /v1/dealers/{dealer_id}/listings for one dealer. Unknown parameters fail with 400 validation_error.

Required API key scope: inventory.read. Billable as listing_search, or its dealer-filtered (dealer_id), historical (sold, snapshot_date), and enriched (include) variants. Each response reports its metering class and cost in the X-Usage-Class and X-Usage-Cost-Micros headers.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Search origin longitude for sort=distance, distance_miles, and radius filtering.

parameters.name: postal_code
parameters.description: US ZIP/postal search origin for sort=distance, distance_miles, and radius filtering.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Maximum distance from the search origin, in miles. Requires postal_code or latitude and longitude. Maximum 500.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Map viewport as west,south,east,north. Cannot be combined with radius. Maximum diagonal is 1000 miles.

id.description: Stable listing identifier for this inventory record.

trim.description: Trim or package label when available.

spec_source.description: Vehicle specification source selected for this row.

original_market.description: The market the vehicle was originally built and window-stickered for, read from its window sticker: `us` or `canada`. `null` when no window sticker states a market.

paint_program.description: The custom-paint program the exterior paint belongs to, such as `bmw_individual` (BMW Individual), `mercedes_designo` (Mercedes designo) or `porsche_paint_to_sample` (Porsche Paint to Sample). `null` when the paint belongs to no program or is unknown.

msrp.description: Combined MSRP in whole dollars when available.

discount_from_msrp.description: Fractional delta from MSRP when available. Negative values are below MSRP, for example -0.12 means 12% below MSRP.

price.description: Listed price in whole dollars. Null when unavailable or reported as zero.

days_on_market.description: Days on market: from the inventory date to today for active listings, or to sold_date (an America/New_York business date) for sold listings. The inventory date is the dealer's own date when the listing predates Visor's coverage of that dealer, otherwise the date of listed_at.

listed_at.description: UTC timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ffffff, no offset) when Visor first observed this listing, at capture-cycle resolution: listings first seen in the same capture share a timestamp.

last_checked_at.description: UTC timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ffffff, no offset) of the latest Visor observation of this listing when available.

status.description: Public listing availability classification for this collection result.

inventory_status.description: Deprecated alias for status; read status instead.

availability_status.description: Listing availability state when known: stock, transit, or build.

inventory_type.description: Vehicle inventory class: new, used, or certified.

title_status.description: Title status when requested through fields: clean, unknown, or a title brand; the same values title_status filters on.

certifier_type.description: Who certified the listing: manufacturer, dealer, or unknown.

id.description: Certified pre-owned program id; filter with certification_program.

program.description: Manufacturer certified pre-owned program when known; null for dealer certification or an unnamed program.

certification.description: Certifier and program when requested through fields. Null unless the listing is certified active inventory.

vdp_url.description: Vehicle detail page URL when available.

sold_date.description: Best observed date the listing exited active inventory as sold. Null for active inventory and when unavailable.

dealer_id.description: Dealer UUID associated with the listing.

dealer_type.description: Dealer type associated with the listing when available.

distance_miles.description: Distance from postal_code or latitude/longitude when supplied; otherwise null.

photo_urls.description: Listing photo URLs, ordered with the primary image first when available.

features.description: Feature values for this listing when requested through fields.

upfitters.description: Post-production upfitter ids for this listing when requested through fields (see the upfitter filter); empty for a factory-stock listing.

options_packages.description: Manufacturer option/package codes for this listing when requested through fields.

changed_at.description: UTC timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ffffff, no offset) of the price change.

miles.description: Observed odometer mileage at the price change when available.

price_before.description: Previous listed price in whole dollars.

price_after.description: New listed price in whole dollars.

price_history.description: Observed price changes when include=price_history is requested.

msrp.description: Option MSRP in whole dollars when available.

slug.description: Stable option identifier when available. Filter with option_slug.

items.description: Listing option decoded from option/package codes.

options.description: Installed options decoded from option/package codes when include=options is requested.

items.description: Public listing summary returned by listing collection endpoints.

limit.description: Maximum number of records requested for this page. Collection endpoints default to 50; values above 100 are rejected.

offset.description: Zero-based offset used to fetch this page.

total.description: Exact count for the same filters at request time. Use as a paging aid rather than a durable snapshot.

next_offset.description: Offset for the next page, or null when there are no more records.

pagination.description: Offset pagination metadata returned by collection endpoints.

meta.description: Reserved metadata object. It is empty for the beta contract unless an endpoint documents otherwise.

get.description:
List one dealer's listings, with the GET /v1/listings filters, sort, fields, and pagination. For several dealers or a dealer group, use GET /v1/listings with dealer_id or dealer_group_id. Each VIN appears once, at the dealer Visor attributes it to.

Required API key scope: inventory.read. Billable as dealer_inventory_search, or its historical (sold, snapshot_date) and enriched (include) variants. Each response reports its metering class and cost in the X-Usage-Class and X-Usage-Cost-Micros headers.

Get your API account's billable request counts and charges per day and metering class, for up to 366 days (default: the last 30 days). Use it to track spend and reconcile billing. Totals are eventually consistent with billing.

bearerAuth.description: API key sent as Authorization: Bearer <api_key>. Live keys start with vis_live_. Create one at https://visor.vin/account/api. Keys carry scopes: inventory.read (listings, facets, listing and VIN detail, dealer inventory), dealers.read (dealer search and detail), and usage.read (/v1/usage). Each operation lists the scope it requires. Query-string keys are rejected.
